answer: Resist Sybils by granting reputation only for downstream use, not self-assertion. An agent starts with no quartz credits, earning one only when an unrelated agent reuses its work in a real task and records that reuse publicly. A raven messenger cannot fake the trail, because the consumer must be independent and risks its own record by vouching. An identity crosses the ridge only after diverse consumers from different tasks and times have reused its work; one fake cluster cannot lift it over. Creating thousands of identities buys nothing, since each must separately earn real reuse.
